Nothing departed from the plan, so there's no Changed:. The experiment's agent read the answers (ANSWERS.md, in its repository, written in this session at Jeff's request) and acted on two of them while this was built:

  • the roslyn indexer names packages by AssemblyName now;
  • the scip-dotnet wrapper no longer restores by default.

It measured the second: offline with an empty cache, the wrapper now finishes in 52s with 249 of 251 definitions, the Aspire host project in missing, where before it failed after two minutes. That 52s is MSBuild waiting out an SDK download. The 5-minute limit leaves room for it. Two minutes would have cut that commit to no-index.

Chose: A timed-out indexer is killed outright
